## Expected normalized layout

Acquire each filing named in the manifest above from SEC EDGAR — `https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar` for company/ticker lookup, then, once you have resolved a filer's CIK, its filing index page at `https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<CIK>/<accession-no-dashes>/` — normalize it to plain text, and place it at `tasks/fav2/corpus/<TICKER>/<filing_date>_<FORM>_<accession>.txt` — the exact layout on disk today, one directory per ticker (41 ticker directories), one file per filing (2,415 files total), no subdirectories beneath the ticker level and no separate manifest/index file alongside the filings themselves (the filename is the index). `tasks/fav2/corpus/` itself is not committed to this repository (`tasks/*/corpus/` is gitignored — pinned corpora are distributed separately); this brief and the corpus content-hash pinned in `bench/pins.json` are what stand in for it here.
